빌레몬서 1:1.content: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

빌레몬서 1:2.content: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

빌레몬서 1:3.content: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

빌레몬서 1:4.content: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

빌레몬서 1:5.content: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

빌레몬서 1:6.content: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

빌레몬서 1:7.content: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

빌레몬서 1:8.content: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

빌레몬서 1:9.content: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

빌레몬서 1:10.content: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

빌레몬서 1:11.content: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

빌레몬서 1:12.content: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

빌레몬서 1:13.content: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

빌레몬서 1:14.content: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

빌레몬서 1:15.content: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

빌레몬서 1:16.content: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

빌레몬서 1:17.content: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

빌레몬서 1:18.content: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

빌레몬서 1:19.content: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

빌레몬서 1:20.content: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

빌레몬서 1:21.content: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

빌레몬서 1:22.content: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

빌레몬서 1:23.content: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

빌레몬서 1:24.content: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

빌레몬서 1:25.content: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.
